_readme: Default template (ruler) for the building type. Spec: prompts/PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §33. The structure is PRESET and orientation is PRESUMED; the code only fills the blanks from the sheets. Edit for another drafter's set of the same type.

envelope.ring: closed ring of walls on the grid axes
envelope.openings: doors D1..D3 and windows W1..W3, sizes from the p8 schedule, positions from the plan

views._presumed: Orientation is presumed, not inferred (owner 2026-11-04). row = which of the sheet's two views. axis = the grid line of the wall that face shows.

beam_above_ffl.read_from: elevations: the long line above the floor line

ffl_above_ground.read_from: elevations: floor line above the ground line

ridge_above_beam.read_from: side elevations: top of the highest line at the roof's pitch

eaves_from_axis.read_from: roof plan: where the sheet ribs end, from the outer axes

wall_thickness.read_from: plan: gap between paired wall pen lines

porch_step_below_ffl.read_from: front elevation: the line between floor and ground

door_head_above_ffl.read_from: elevations: top of the door's outer frame verticals, standing on the floor line

door_frame_face.read_from: elevations: outer to inner frame vertical

roof_pitch_deg.read_from: side elevations: the long straight lines that are neither level nor plumb

floor_buildup.read_from: sections: FFL level line down to the chromatic membrane line, where one is drawn

window_system._status: YELLOW: template defaults, the drawing does not state a profile. Overall sizes and panels come from the p8 schedule, depth from the plan.

W1.text: M.B alum. 3 panel frame adjustable window

W2.text: M.B alum. 2 panel frame adjustable window

W3.text: M.B alum. frame single panel, top hung adjustable window

room_tag._spec: §36: the room tag's box and pens in mm, so they follow the print scale. read_max_mm and margin_mm are set from measurements, not to be widened to pass.

door_arc._spec: §39: what a door's swing arc looks like, measured on this type's plan: leaves 669-900 mm in the 0.72 pt pen; the one fixture arc 559 mm in the 0.12 pt pen. Not tied to the schedule's widths: a schedule that disagrees with the plan must not lose the door.

style_search._spec: §40: where the sheet's own style is looked for. Read once in fill_blanks.py, written to template.effective.json; every later stage uses what was read.

door_system._status: §38. Frame face is read on p4 (door_frame_face). Leaf thickness is a template default, YELLOW: not drawn at a readable scale. Knob, lock, swing and finish are not modelled.

D1.text: Metal frame, Single leaf solid timber door
